message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing a noise issue in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the City of Atlanta’s authorities. Noise complaints are generally handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** (APD) rather than a city council office. Here’s how you can do it: | Method | How to File | Contact | |--------|-------------|---------| | **Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and use the “Noise Complaint” form.
URL: https://www.atlantaga.gov/ | N/A | | **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line.
Number: **404‑656‑4000** (for general inquiries) or **404‑656‑4000** (for noise complaints specifically). | 404‑656‑4000 | | **In‑person** | Go to the nearest APD precinct or the City Hall’s public service desk. | City Hall: 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | **Mail** | Send a written complaint to:
City of Atlanta – Public Service Office
1000 Peachtree Street NW
Atlanta, GA 30303 | 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | ### What to Include in Your Complaint 1. **Your name and contact information** (phone, email, address). 2. **Date(s) and time(s)** when the noise occurred. 3. **Location** (street address or intersection). 4. **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 5. **Any evidence** (photos, videos, audio recordings). ### Tips - **Non‑emergencies**: Use the non‑emergency line (404‑656‑4000) unless the situation poses an immediate safety risk. - **Follow up**: If you don’t receive a response within a few days, call back or check the online portal for updates. - **Local ordinances**: Noise regulations are governed by the City of Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 12 of the Atlanta Municipal Code). You can review the ordinance on the city’s website for specific thresholds and permissible hours. If you prefer to involve the city council directly, you can bring the issue to your local council member’s office. However, the council typically delegates enforcement to the police department, so filing through the APD is the most direct route.
